subject: Weekly exec snapshot: wins, top risks, and priority asks (6/9)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly exec snapshot: wins, top risks, and priority asks (6/9)

Team —

Quick pulse ahead of QBR planning: sending a short list of wins, current risks that need leadership input, and two asks (one tactical, one decision). I’ve attached a 2-slide priority deck for the exec meeting.

Wins
- Hosted API latency P50 improved 12% week-over-week after the kernel patch; infra rollouts on track.
- Closed pilot with Nimbus Analytics — first paid POC started last week (contract signed).
- Observability: console now surfaces token-level traces for 90% of production routes (helps debugging cost hotspots).

Top risks
- Dedicated capacity autoscale edge cases: two capacity drops last Friday caused short throttling for Dedicated customers (impact <1% of requests but visible to a customer). Root cause points to our scheduling heuristic.
- Q2 hiring shortfall: applied hires in serving runtime behind plan by ~25%; could slow feature milestones in July.
- SLA exception request from a large prospect (Nimbus) that asks for a 99.95% latency SLO for a portion of traffic — needs legal/finance guidance.

Asks
1) Tactical: Can Infra + Runtime triage the autoscale heuristic and propose a short mitigation by EOD Fri? If not, we should prepare a fallback routing policy (temp) for affected Dedicated nodes.
2) Decision: Approve negotiation levers for the Nimbus SLA exception (we can accept a phased SLO tied to traffic ramp; need signoff on a 6-month credit cap).

Notes/attachments
- Attached: QBR_prio_slide_deck.pdf (2 pages) — two slides: a one-pager wins/risks and a proposed ask/decision for the exec meeting.
- Drive link with charts: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1A2bQBR-prio-deck

Thanks — will consolidate responses by 1pm PT for the QBR prep doc.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly exec snapshot: wins, top risks, and priority asks (6/9)

Vivek — thanks for the concise breakdown. A couple quick notes: 

- On wins: great work on the latency improvements — please add the 7-day trend (P50/P95) to slide 1 so we can show momentum.
- On the autoscale issue: assign Markus to lead the mitigation and ask him to include a short blameless postmortem bullet in the QBR slide.
- Nimbus SLA: I support a phased SLO if Finance accepts a time-bound credit cap. Finance, please weigh in (cc not included here — I’ll loop them in if we get consensus).

Ask from Product: can we get one small chart showing user-facing error rates for affected Dedicated routes (last 48h)? This will help prioritize the mitigation.

Laura Bennett
Chief Product Officer
Redwood Inference
